instrument.description: One serving issuer in window 1 (F1), enforcement against an issuer that cannot serve in windows 2 and 3. ISSUER-B is registered first and ISSUER-A second, both lots bonded at deploy; after window 1 the operator drains ISSUER-B so later windows route to ISSUER-A. One issuer per window is configuration in this record, never code.

capacityLots.note: Fixtures identical to the fifth trio, by decision (plan D1): both classes per issuer, 1 USDC bonded per lot. issuanceLimit = committedCapacityHours * measuredRateMilliSiuPerHour * 0.5 (CapacityBond.ISSUANCE_RATIO_BPS); bondedUsdc plays no part in it. Bonded B first, then A, by cli/bond-lots.ts — registration order is routing priority — which writes each lot's transactions into bondTransactions below. Extract lots are bonded and unused by a code-class run; they are NOT available headroom for a code-class job.
capacityLots.rateFiguresAreFixtures: Neither committedCapacityHours nor measuredRateMilliSiuPerHour is a measurement; they are scenario parameters chosen to give the issuance limits below while keeping the deliberate inequality between the two issuers.
